Born in Tokyo in 1969. Entered the culinary world at the age of 21 and trained in the United States for two years. After returning to Japan, he learned about ingredients in Hokkaido and trained for ten years at a traditional Japanese restaurant in Kyoto. He has since gained a wide range of experience, including Italian, French, and overseeing school cafeteria menus. In 2016, he opened "Shinsen Kappo Sano-ya." He creates dishes that are not bound by tradition, incorporating techniques such as espuma and liquid nitrogen, while focusing on traditional styles of kaiseki that emphasize dashi and seasonal ingredients, providing a culinary experience that delights the eyes, palate, and heart.

Food Enjoy sushi made with Onomichi vinegar rice and seasonal seafood carefully selected by our skilled chefs.

We use pure red vinegar from the traditional Onomichi vinegar brewery for our sushi rice. The fragrant and mellow flavor of the vinegar perfectly complements the firm rice. Our skilled chefs select fresh seafood daily from Toyosu, allowing you to enjoy seasonal catches. Savor the perfect balance of the vinegar's tanginess and the freshness of the toppings in our carefully crafted sushi.

Food Craftsmanship Shines in Our "Omakase Course" ◆ We Also Suggest Sake That Pairs Well with the Dishes

We offer an omakase course featuring carefully selected ingredients of the day. Experience the changing seasons through a variety of exquisite dishes crafted by skilled artisans. Our staff, certified in sake, will suggest pairings that complement your meal. Enjoy detailed explanations of the drinks for a richer dining experience. Savor a delightful time where taste, presentation, and conversation come together in harmony.

SpaceCounter seats with smartphone holders ♦ Enjoy the vibrant skills of our artisans

Nestled close to Shibuya Station, Sushi Teppei offers a serene escape from the city's hustle and bustle. Step inside and you'll find a calm atmosphere that invites you to relax. Our counter seats come with smartphone holders, allowing you to capture the skilled hands of our sushi chefs as they prepare your meal. Enjoy engaging conversations with the chefs, and feel free to ask about the fish or the history of our restaurant in a friendly setting. Experience the unique entertainment that delights all your senses at our establishment.

ServiceSurprise performances available. A unique space perfect for birthdays and anniversaries.
